test_schedule.race: Memory/Mmap, pause before and after shared registration, actual aborted-gap reclaim, single MAXu32 to zero wrap, wait for worker idle before counting wakes, complete producer before cleanup rescue.
test_schedule.multiple: Memory/Mmap, cut captured and registered before Full producers, three registrations survive timed caller detach, real worker error and closing paths unwind, native futex forwarded, completion asserted before rescue.
test_schedule.saturation: Memory/Mmap, real shared registration from UINT64MAX-1 enters permanent sentinel; exits preserve it and later no-waiter close notifications still wake.
